svg.title: The three layers of a hotel record
svg.desc: One hotel record is three layers. Public facts, seen by every agency, are at the bottom. The agency's deals and commission, seen only inside the agency, are in the middle, in gold because the agency has checked them. The advisor's own notes, seen only by them until they share them, are on top.
